name: algebra-lab
description: Solve your equations and check each side.

interface.longDescription: Solve your equations and check each side. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Solve ax + b = cx + d; Solve two linear equations; Build a function table. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me solve ax + b = cx + d.
Help me solve two linear equations.

prompts: Help me solve ax + b = cx + d.
Help me solve two linear equations.
Help me build a function table.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Balance Point: Algebra I workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Solve ax + b = cx + d. Reproducible inputs: {"a":3,"b":7,"c":1,"d":15}
positive.prompt: Help me solve ax + b = cx + d with these supplied values: {"a":3,"b":7,"c":1,"d":15}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_lab_solve_linear with the supplied inputs. Returns {"x":4,"steps":["2x = 8","x = 8/2"],"left":19,"right":19}. Shows the actual balance result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Solve two linear equations. Reproducible inputs: {"a":2,"b":1,"c":7,"d":1,"e":-1,"f":2}
positive.prompt: Help me solve two linear equations with these supplied values: {"a":2,"b":1,"c":7,"d":1,"e":-1,"f":2}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_lab_solve_system with the supplied inputs. Returns {"x":3,"y":1,"checks":[7,2],"determinant":-3}. Shows the actual plot result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Build a function table. Reproducible inputs: {"slope":2,"intercept":-3,"x_values":[-2,-1,0,1,2]}
positive.prompt: Help me build a function table with these supplied values: {"slope":2,"intercept":-3,"x_values":[-2,-1,0,1,2]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_lab_linear_table with the supplied inputs. Returns {"points":[{"x":-2,"y":-7},{"x":-1,"y":-5},{"x":0,"y":-3},{"x":1,"y":-1},{"x":2,"y":1}]}. Shows the actual plot result. Does not fabricate external data.
